fusions.name: Loosed Self
fusions.desc: A leaping strike at an enemy up to 9 tiles away that deals 28 piercing damage, up to 2 times that at the full 9 tiles. It ignores armour.

fusions.name: Quiver of Biters
fusions.desc: You loose 3 fleas in a spread out to 7 tiles, each dealing 3 damage to the enemy it strikes. It holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Coiled Release
fusions.desc: After a 0.6 second draw, you launch 6 tiles forward and move 20% faster for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Taut Legs
fusions.desc: When your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 30% for 4 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
